overview_description.description:
Seven in ten GCC consumers are actively pursuing wellness — from nutrition and beauty to therapies and retreats — but the journey is chaotic. They bounce between four or five platforms with unsatisfactory results because nothing personalizes it to who they are.
Mudra solves this with the region’s first all-in-one wellness ecosystem — where users take a quick quiz, get personalized recommendations, and discover trusted brands, practitioners, and retreats.
